bridges.connector: ⟨u, v⟩ = 0 defines orthogonality; ⟨0, v⟩ = 0 for every v (two different readings)
bridges.doesNotProve: that every zero is an orthogonality, or reading C/D of "0 is orthogonal"
bridges.assumptions: an inner-product space
bridges.failureCondition: none for the identity; readings C and D of "0 is orthogonal" are not implied

bridges.connector: x = Σ⟨x, e_k⟩e_k for an orthonormal basis; residual of a projection ⟂ retained part
bridges.doesNotProve: that decomposition needs orthogonality (frames decompose without it)
bridges.assumptions: an orthonormal basis (complete, for L²)
bridges.failureCondition: non-orthogonal frames also decompose: orthogonality is sufficient, not necessary

bridges.connector: ‖x‖² = Σ|a_k|² exactly when cross terms vanish
bridges.doesNotProve: that ‖x‖² is physical energy
bridges.assumptions: mutually orthogonal components
bridges.failureCondition: nonzero cross terms between components

bridges.connector: ‖f‖² = Σ|f̂(k)|² (unitary change of representation)
bridges.doesNotProve: anything about phase (Parseval sees magnitudes only)
bridges.assumptions: an orthonormal basis; f ∈ L²
bridges.failureCondition: none for the theorem (phase is not seen)

bridges.connector: T_τ e_k = e^{−2πikτ}e_k
bridges.doesNotProve: that phase can be recovered from magnitudes (it cannot: P1b, P1c)
bridges.assumptions: the project convention x̂(ω) = ∫x e^{−iωt}dt (series: e_k = e^{2πikt})
bridges.failureCondition: another sign convention flips the sign of the phase

bridges.connector: D_x(τ) = 1 − ρ_x(τ) (normalized, unitary translation)
bridges.doesNotProve: that the defect function determines the signal (it determines the autocorrelation only)
bridges.assumptions: x ∈ L², x ≠ 0; T_τ unitary; the project's normalization
bridges.failureCondition: a non-unitary transformation (the defect formula changes)

bridges.connector: ∫⟨x, T_τx⟩e^{iωτ}dτ = |x̂(ω)|² (energy signals); Wiener–Khinchin: power spectrum = transform of the autocorrelation
bridges.doesNotProve: that the spectrum determines the signal (P1b, P1c)
bridges.assumptions: energy signals (convolution theorem) or wide-sense stationary processes (Khintchine)
bridges.failureCondition: the spectrum does not determine the signal (FB1d)

bridges.connector: D_x(g) = 0 ⟺ U_g x = x ⟺ g ∈ G_x
bridges.doesNotProve: that a small nonzero defect means g is near the stabilizer in the group (it measures distance in signal space)
bridges.assumptions: a unitary representation U_g
bridges.failureCondition: a non-unitary U_g

bridges.connector: D_x''(0) = ∫ω² dμ_x (exact, finite second moment); D_x(τ) = (τ²/2)∫ω² dμ_x + o(τ²)
bridges.doesNotProve: that it is the uncertainty inequality (a different statement)
bridges.assumptions: a finite spectral second moment (x′ ∈ L²)
bridges.failureCondition: the box function: D = |τ|, not twice differentiable (FB2c)

bridges.connector: AᵀMA = M ⟺ B_M preserved; zero relations of B_M preserved
bridges.doesNotProve: that every geometry is a bilinear form (CF3, the common-form candidate is a hypothesis)
bridges.assumptions: a bilinear or sesquilinear form B_M
bridges.failureCondition: zero-resultant preservation is not a form preservation (CF3)

bridges.connector: exp(sK) preserves M ⟺ KᵀM + MK = 0
bridges.doesNotProve: that the generators of different geometries are physically the same
bridges.assumptions: a one-parameter group exp(sK); constant M
bridges.failureCondition: none for the theorem

bridges.connector: d/dt(zᵀMz) = 0 ⟺ KᵀM + MK = 0; dH/dt = ∇HᵀJ∇H = 0
bridges.doesNotProve: that the project's linear card is Noether's theorem: the general theorem is source-only (FB5 cards one instance)
bridges.assumptions: a Lagrangian with a continuous symmetry, on solutions; or constant antisymmetric J with time-independent H
bridges.failureCondition: no symmetry (FB5b); explicit time dependence (FB5c)

bridges.connector: t ∈ ℝ ↦ e^{iωt} ∈ S¹; s ↦ tanh s ∈ (−1, 1)
bridges.doesNotProve: that every bounded geometry repeats (★ is a hypothesis)
bridges.assumptions: the two stated maps
bridges.failureCondition: a bounded geometry without repetition would not follow (★ is open)

bridges.connector: ΛᵀηΛ = η with η = diag(1, −1/c²)
bridges.doesNotProve: the user hypothesis that the two roles are linked
bridges.assumptions: η_c = diag(1, −1/c²) in 1 + 1 dimensions
bridges.failureCondition: none for the identity

bridges.connector: c → ∞: η_c → diag(1, 0), boost → Galilean shear
bridges.doesNotProve: that spacetime and model manifolds are the same object
bridges.assumptions: c → ∞ with the time coordinate fixed
bridges.failureCondition: the c → 0 contraction is a different group (Carroll)

bridges.connector: g = JᵀJ/σ² for Gaussian noise
bridges.doesNotProve: that sloppiness equals spectral decay (C7 open)
bridges.assumptions: independent Gaussian noise with equal known σ; differentiable Y(θ)
bridges.failureCondition: unequal noise levels: JᵀΣ⁻¹J (FB6b)

bridges.connector: g v = 0 ⟺ v changes no prediction (to first order)
bridges.doesNotProve: that a statistical null is a quadratic null of an indefinite form (OB1 keeps them apart)
bridges.assumptions: g = JᵀJ/σ² positive semidefinite
bridges.failureCondition: a small nonzero eigenvalue is sloppy, not null (FB7c)

bridges.connector: ∫ψ = 0: a wavelet sums to zero by design
bridges.doesNotProve: that scattering proves the zero hypothesis
bridges.assumptions: ψ ∈ L¹ ∩ L², admissible
bridges.failureCondition: a nonzero-mean filter is not admissible (FB10b)

bridges.connector: |f ∗ ψ| removes phase; averaging removes position; the next order recovers part of what averaging removed
bridges.doesNotProve: that this mechanism equals Fourier phase loss or dephasing; that Mallat's theorems bear on the zero hypothesis as proof
bridges.assumptions: admissible wavelets and an averaging scale, with the exact hypotheses of the source
bridges.failureCondition: the first-order invariant is many-to-one (FB10c)

bridges.connector: v_i = P_n e_i; source recovered as v_i + w (|w|² = 1/n) when the class is known
bridges.doesNotProve: recovery without knowing the class (G4c obstruction)
bridges.assumptions: orthonormal source; orthogonal projection onto 1^⊥; source class known
bridges.failureCondition: source class unknown (G4c)

bridges.connector: independent group acting covariantly on the zero-producing tuple; commuting hidden quadratic scalar on irreducible blocks (Schur)
bridges.doesNotProve: that hidden information is in general symmetry information (mass inverts the roles)
bridges.assumptions: an independently supplied group acting covariantly; a hidden quadratic commuting with it
bridges.failureCondition: the roles invert between spins and masses

bridges.connector: Σm(r − R_CM) = 0 ⟺ ⟨1, C_m x⟩_D = 0; C_m D-orthogonal
bridges.doesNotProve: that WMC and T′ are one geometry beyond the operator family C_G
bridges.assumptions: positive weights
bridges.failureCondition: Σm = 0 or non-positive weights

bridges.connector: R_CM = (1/n)1 at r_i = e_i, so r_i − R_CM = P_n e_i
bridges.doesNotProve: a universal Pair A solution
bridges.assumptions: equal masses at r_i = e_i
bridges.failureCondition: unequal masses (G4m)

bridges.connector: zero sum + full permutation symmetry ⇒ Gram ∝ I − J/n (G3c)
bridges.doesNotProve: the converse (FS2d)
bridges.assumptions: a zero sum and full S_n symmetry
bridges.failureCondition: the converse fails (FS2d)

bridges.connector: Σ L x_i = 0 ⟺ Σx_i ∈ ker L
bridges.doesNotProve: that zero = kernel (inherited and nonlinear zeros, G4c, Z5a)
bridges.assumptions: L linear
bridges.failureCondition: nonlinear and inherited zeros (Z5a, G4c)

bridges.connector: non-selective projective measurement: off-diagonal blocks → 0; zero-diagonal observables lose their expectation
bridges.doesNotProve: that it is the same physical mechanism as which-path (generic map only)
bridges.assumptions: a non-selective projective measurement
bridges.failureCondition: a selective measurement; the same physical mechanism as which-path is not shown

bridges.connector: E² = p²c² + m²c⁴ with E = ħω, p = ħk
bridges.doesNotProve: that mass is waves (MW1 stays a hypothesis)
bridges.assumptions: E = ħω and p = ħk as inputs
bridges.failureCondition: without these inputs; non-relativistic dispersion (FB8c)

bridges.connector: none found (open)
bridges.doesNotProve: any shared geometry
bridges.assumptions: none established
bridges.failureCondition: S14a FAIL kept; no operator found

bridges.connector: ω(v, v) = vᵀJv = 0 for every v (alternating); q_η(v) = vᵀηv = 0 only on the light cone
bridges.doesNotProve: that "null" names one object: alternating self-pairing zero ≠ Lorentz quadratic null vector
bridges.assumptions: J antisymmetric; η indefinite
bridges.failureCondition: none: the distinction holds for every antisymmetric J and indefinite η

bridges.connector: for g ⪰ 0: vᵀgv = 0 ⟺ gv = 0 ⟺ Jv = 0; for η: vᵀηv = 0 with ηv ≠ 0
bridges.doesNotProve: that a model-manifold null and a light-like vector are one kind of zero
bridges.assumptions: g positive semidefinite; η indefinite
bridges.failureCondition: none: the distinction holds for every such pair

bridges.connector: for real x with finite moments: D_x''(0) = Δω² ≥ 1/(4Δt²)
bridges.doesNotProve: that the defect identity is the uncertainty theorem (two different results)
bridges.assumptions: x real; finite second moments in t and ω
bridges.failureCondition: complex x adds ω̄² to D''(0) (FB2d)

bridges.connector: dC/dt = 0 ⇒ rate = V_max S/(K_M + S): (k₁, k₋₁, k₂) → (K_M, V_max)
bridges.doesNotProve: that every reduction is one mechanism (H6)
bridges.assumptions: mass action; e₀/(S₀ + K_M) ≪ 1
bridges.failureCondition: e₀ comparable to S₀ + K_M (FB11b)

bridges.connector: θ₂ → ∞: e^{−θ₁t} + e^{−θ₂t} → e^{−θ₁t}, ∂Y/∂θ₂ → 0
bridges.doesNotProve: the MBAM procedure in general
bridges.failureCondition: a boundary limit is not the MBAM geodesic procedure

bridges.connector: Σ_{s₂} e^{Ks₂(s₁+s₃)} = A e^{K′s₁s₃}, tanh K′ = tanh²K
bridges.doesNotProve: RG fixed-point theory in general; H6 beyond one example
bridges.assumptions: zero field, nearest-neighbour couplings
bridges.failureCondition: a field h ≠ 0 needs a renormalized field too (FB11d)

bridges.connector: (F*B)(u, v) = uᵀ(AᵀMA)v for F(x) = Ax and constant B_M (A†HA = H for Hermitian forms); in general (F*T)_x = dF_xᵀ M(F(x)) dF_x
bridges.doesNotProve: that every geometry is pullback-invariant; that the preserving classes are alike; that a reparametrization is F*g = g (BR-CF-PULLBACK)
bridges.assumptions: a pairing T of tangent vectors; F smooth (linear for the matrix form)
bridges.failureCondition: none for the identity; a map that is not a symmetry fails F*T = T (CFT1c, CFT2b)

bridges.connector: θ = θ(φ): g_φ = Jᵀ g(θ(φ)) J, verified against direct Fisher computation; ds², vector lengths, K and rank invariant; component eigenvalues not
bridges.doesNotProve: that a coordinate change is a symmetry (it is never written F*g = g)
bridges.assumptions: a regular model; an invertible reparametrization J
bridges.failureCondition: a coordinate-dependent pseudo-structure fails the law (CFT10a); component eigenvalues change (CFT5e)

bridges.connector: Y∘S = Y ⇒ S*g = g and Jv = 0 at fixed points for dS v = −v
bridges.doesNotProve: that Fisher nulls require a symmetry (F-C′ has one without, CFT5c)
bridges.assumptions: an involution S with Y∘S = Y; a fixed point of S
bridges.failureCondition: no symmetry: the lemma predicts nothing, and a null can still occur (CFT5c)

bridges.connector: normal family: the isometry group of g (3-dimensional) strictly contains the location–scale group (2-dimensional) induced by x ↦ ax + b
bridges.doesNotProve: that "admissible" means "preserves T": the two classes differ
bridges.assumptions: the normal family with its Fisher metric
bridges.failureCondition: none: the hyperbolic inversion is an isometry no data map induces (CFT11a)

bridges.connector: R3: C_m is a D-orthogonal, D-self-adjoint projector, not an isometry; A C_m = C_m A exactly for D-isometries preserving the line span{1}
bridges.doesNotProve: that C_m is a structure-preserving transformation (it is a derived, equivariant operator)
bridges.assumptions: positive weights; D = diag(m)
bridges.failureCondition: a D-isometry not preserving span{1}, or a non-isometry fixing 1, does not commute (CFT8c)

bridges.connector: R1: x = Px′ gives M′ = PᵀMP; a metric changes as g_φ = Jᵀ g_θ J, vectors as v_φ = J⁻¹ v_θ; scalars (B(x, y), ds²) unchanged
bridges.doesNotProve: that a representation change is a symmetry or a physical change; lossy maps (projections) are not R1 (TRA4b)
bridges.assumptions: an invertible change of representation (P or J invertible)
bridges.failureCondition: a non-invertible map is not a change of representation (TRA4b)

bridges.connector: R2: F is a symmetry of T ⟺ F*T = T ⟺ T_{F(x)}(dF u, dF v) = T_x(u, v)
bridges.doesNotProve: that all geometry is F*T = T; that the preserving classes of different T are alike (CFT2c)
bridges.assumptions: a pairing T of tangent vectors; F a smooth map of the space to itself
bridges.failureCondition: a non-symmetry fails (CFT1c, CFT2b, CFT4d)

bridges.connector: F_t*T = T for all t ⟹ L_X T = 0; matrix case A(t)ᵀMA(t) = M ⟹ KᵀM + MK = 0 (K†M + MK = 0)
bridges.doesNotProve: conservation without Noether's assumptions; the converse (L_X T = 0 ⟹ global symmetry) needs a complete flow
bridges.assumptions: a smooth one-parameter group F_t with generator X
bridges.failureCondition: a non-Killing field: L_X g ≠ 0 (TRA1b)

bridges.connector: F*T = T and T(u, v) = 0 ⟹ T(dF u, dF v) = 0; constant forms: A†MA = M ⟹ (B_M(x, y) = 0 ⟹ B_M(Ax, Ay) = 0)
bridges.doesNotProve: that every zero is generated by symmetry or arises from a preserved form; the converse fails (2I keeps every zero, TRA2b)
bridges.assumptions: F*T = T
bridges.failureCondition: the converse fails: zero preservation without invariance (TRA2b)

bridges.connector: Aut(T) = {F : F*T = T} is the stabilizer of T under the action of maps on structures; for a group acting on x, G_x = {g : g·x = x}; D_x(g) = 0 ⟺ g ∈ G_x (Z8)
bridges.doesNotProve: that an automorphism group of a structure equals the signal stabilizer of Z8 (they act on different objects)
bridges.assumptions: a group acting on a set (structures, or signals)
bridges.failureCondition: none for the identity; the two stabilizers concern different objects

bridges.connector: R3: F T_a = M_a F, i.e. (T_a f)^(ω) = e^{−iωa} f̂(ω): translation in one representation ↔ phase multiplication in another
bridges.doesNotProve: that the Fourier transform is a physical spacetime symmetry; that T_a and M_a are the same operator
bridges.assumptions: the project convention x̂(ω) = ∫x e^{−iωt}dt; the DFT for the discrete form
bridges.failureCondition: none for the identity; a different sign convention flips the phase

bridges.connector: an operator commuting with a group action preserves its isotypic sectors and is scalar on each multiplicity-free irreducible block (Schur)
bridges.doesNotProve: labels beyond known ones (four spins: VALIDATION OF KNOWN MATHEMATICS); that particle exchange is universal
bridges.assumptions: a finite group (or compact group) acting linearly; an operator commuting with the action
bridges.failureCondition: with multiplicities, an operator need not be scalar on an isotypic sector

bridges.connector: Pₙ is not invertible and does not keep inner products (Pe₁·Pe₂ = −1/3 while e₁·e₂ = 0); its transformation relationship is R3 (commutes with permutations)
bridges.doesNotProve: that a lossy representation map is a covariant change of description
bridges.assumptions: Pₙ = I − 11ᵀ/n
bridges.failureCondition: none: the distinction holds for every n ≥ 2

bridges.connector: (T_τx) ∗ ψ = T_τ(x ∗ ψ); Σ|x ⊛ ψ| invariant under circular shifts
bridges.doesNotProve: deformation stability or higher-order recovery (source-only)
bridges.assumptions: convolution with a fixed wavelet; circular shifts for the discrete invariant
bridges.failureCondition: the invariant is many-to-one (FB10c)
